decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a cheap plugin on the core map.apps platform, but with no visible activity since 2018 its value is still unproven, so the option stays open at modest risk.

The hierarchical search bundle has had thin evidence of demand from the start and has not been seen since, which weakens its value, but keeping it as a low-cost add-on still beats paying to withdraw it.
VueTOC was a small Vue-based component announced once and not observed afterwards, so it may be absorbed into newer map.apps releases, but dropping it is not yet clearly justified.
The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic foundation, so it is a committed investment rather than a marginal option and will stay on the market.
Mobile field data capture fits steady enterprise and public-sector demand and has its own page, so its option value justifies keeping it despite little recent visible evidence.
